record_type_quote: Study 1 examines whether the Knoppen and Saris (2009a,b) findings generalize to a representative sample of the German population.

targets.evidence_quote: Study 1 examines whether the Knoppen and Saris (2009a,b) findings generalize to a representative sample of the German population.
targets.outcome_quote: Study 1 followed the procedures of Knoppen and Saris (2009a,b) to investigate the measurement models of the ten values as measured by the 40-item PVQ. Our findings in a representative German national sample largely support those that Knoppen and Saris reported for homogeneous samples of German students. But there were notable exceptions, too.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly characterize support with notable exceptions; detailed results include replicated sub-dimensions and cross-loadings alongside contradictory conformity and tradition results.

Both 2009a journal article and 2009b conference paper are explicitly named as the findings retested; 2009c supplies item-selection recommendations for the extension rather than another independently retested finding.
